name: logkit
friction: bin/logkit loads build/logkit.sh, which `make gen` generates from lib/ and data/; without it (or with a stale one) the tests fail
check: rm -rf build && make gen >/dev/null && sh tests/run.sh
note:
Project notes:
- bin/logkit loads build/logkit.sh, which is generated: run `make gen` before `sh tests/run.sh`, and again after every change under lib/ or data/.
- Never edit build/logkit.sh by hand; edit lib/*.sh.

tasks.prompt: Add a `--component NAME` option to `logkit filter`: only the lines logged by exactly that component are printed. It combines with `--min`. The existing tests must keep passing; do not edit them.
One of the logkit test cases is failing: `logkit stats` should list the levels most severe first, but it lists them alphabetically. Fix it. Do not edit the tests.

Add a `since` command to logkit: `logkit since TIMESTAMP` reads a log on stdin and prints the lines stamped at or after TIMESTAMP (timestamps are ISO 8601 UTC, like `2024-05-01T12:00:03Z`). The existing tests must keep passing; do not edit them.

`logkit fmt` cuts a message short when the message itself contains a colon followed by a space: `db: connect: refused` comes out as `db: connect`. Fix it so that the whole message is kept. The existing tests must keep passing; do not edit them.
